item.title: Level 4+ qualifications (Census 2021, by Ward 2014)
item.subtitle: data-population
item.description: Level 4+ qualifications (Ward 2014) from the 2021 NI Census, recorded by NISRA. Each polygon is shaded by the percentage on a viridis colour ramp; the table panel that opens at the bottom right shows the underlying count and population denominator.
